title: gf2-sim: live per-SNR tracing + multi-SNR kill/resume test for DVB-T2 campaign
description:
## Goal

Close the two gf2-sim campaign-binary gaps that block epic `2928ccce`
from satisfying its [hard] observability and resume criteria (surfaced
by the epic-level code-review on 2026-06-13). The DVB-T2 AWGN campaign
binary migrated to the gf2-sim pipeline (`bbf6b6ee`) regressed two
properties relative to the parent epic's criteria.

## Context

Binary: `crates/gf2-sim/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs`.
Executor sweep: `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/drain.rs`
(`Scheduler::run_sweep_checkpointed`, per-SNR loop ~line 32-50 where each
`SnrPointResult::from_counters(es_n0_db, run.counters)` is pushed).

## Deliverables

### 1. Live `snr_point_completed` tracing

Today (`dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs:1039`) the `snr_point_completed` tracing
events are emitted POST-SWEEP, after `run_sweep_checkpointed` returns —
only `campaign_heartbeat` is live. Epic `2928ccce` [hard] criterion
requires: "All campaign progress is emitted as structured `tracing`
events to a JSON file (one record per SNR point completion plus
configurable per-N-frames heartbeats), tailable with `jq` during the
run."

Emit one `snr_point_completed` tracing event LIVE at each SNR-point
boundary during the sweep (inside the checkpointed sweep loop, right
after each point's `SnrPointResult` is available / its checkpoint is
written), carrying at least `es_n0_db`, `fer`, `frames`, `errors`,
`mean_iters`. Keep the existing event name and field schema so existing
`jq`/parsing keeps working. Do NOT keep a duplicate post-sweep emission
that would double-log each point (the post-sweep loop at lines 1045-1057
should be removed or made conditional so each point is logged exactly
once). The non-checkpointed `run_with_decoder` calibration path may keep
its post-run emission (calibration is short and not the production
criterion), but document the distinction.

Verify the field schema and `jq`-tailability are preserved; add/adjust a
unit or integration test asserting a `snr_point_completed` record is
written to the tracing JSON before the sweep completes (e.g. a 2-point
run where the first point's record appears while the second is still
running, or by asserting record ordering interleaved with heartbeats).

### 2. Multi-SNR kill/resume integration test

`crates/gf2-sim/tests/campaign_cli_flags.rs::cli_resume_byte_identical_to_uninterrupted`
uses a SINGLE SNR point (`--esn0-range 6.25:6.25:0.5`), so it does not
exercise the epic [hard] criterion: "A campaign run interrupted by
SIGINT or process kill AFTER AT LEAST ONE SNR POINT HAS COMPLETED resumes
from the NEXT UNFINISHED SNR POINT on restart, without recomputing
finished work ... validated by an integration test that kills the runner
mid-campaign and verifies the resumed CSV is bit-identical to an
uninterrupted reference run with the same seed."

Add an integration test (in `campaign_cli_flags.rs` or a sibling) that:
- runs the campaign binary over MULTIPLE SNR points (>= 3),
- kills the process (SIGINT or SIGKILL) after at least one SNR point has
  completed (its `snr_<NNNN>.json` checkpoint exists) but before the
  sweep finishes,
- restarts with `--resume`,
- asserts the resumed run does NOT recompute the already-completed
  point(s) (e.g. the completed checkpoint's mtime / frame count is
  unchanged across the restart, or via a tracing/stderr signal), and
- asserts the final CSV is byte-identical to an uninterrupted reference
  run at the same seed on the deterministic columns
  (`es_n0_db, fer, frames, errors, mean_iters`) — matching the existing
  single-SNR test's column contract (per `152388f4` the `wall_seconds`
  and `ber` columns are excluded).
- Mark `#[ignore = "sim: ..."]` (spawns full-codec subprocesses) per the
  test-tier rules; keep per-test wall-clock within the slow tier.

## Success criteria

- [hard] `snr_point_completed` tracing events are emitted live during the
  checkpointed production sweep (one per SNR point, at the point
  boundary), each carrying `es_n0_db, fer, frames, errors, mean_iters`,
  and each point is logged exactly once (no post-sweep duplicate).
- [hard] A multi-SNR (>= 3 point) kill/resume integration test exists
  that kills mid-campaign after >= 1 completed SNR point, resumes,
  asserts completed points are not recomputed, and asserts CSV
  byte-identity to an uninterrupted reference on
  `es_n0_db, fer, frames, errors, mean_iters`.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-sim --release --profile ci` passes
  (fast tier); the new ignored test runs green when invoked explicitly.
- [hard] No stale narrative: update the `dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs:1039`
  comment and any doc that says completion events are post-sweep only.

## Non-goals

- No change to the numerical results or the committed curves.
- No change to the CPU-vs-GPU byte-identity contract (§11) — `ber` and
  `wall_seconds` remain excluded from determinism.
- Do not touch files outside `crates/gf2-sim/` except doc comments made
  stale by this change.
